op andere pagina's verborgen {%- endcomment -%}{%- if request.page_type == 'index' -%}<style>body:not(.ap-chat-on) shopify-chat,body:not(.ap-chat-on) #shopify-chat{display:none!important}</style><script>(function(){function f(){if(window.scrollY>400){document.body.classList.add('ap-chat-on');window.removeEventListener('scroll',f);}}window.addEventListener('scroll',f,{passive:true});})();</script>{%- else -%}<style>shopify-chat,#shopify-chat{display:none!important}</style>{%- endif -%}
